gloss: to look forward to; to long for

definitions.gloss: to look forward to; to long for
definitions.explanation: To wait eagerly and hopefully for something good to come, often for a long time. Common as {待|ま}ち{望|のぞ}んでいた (long-awaited).

examples.japanese: {待|ま}ち{望|のぞ}んで⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦{新作|しんさく}→新作：09523_shinsaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ついに⟦{発売|はつばい}→発売：04315_hatsubai⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The long-awaited new title has finally come out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{戦争|せんそう}→戦争：01450_sensou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{終|お}わり、⟦{人々|ひとびと}→人々：03141_hitobito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{待|ま}ち{望|のぞ}んで⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦{平和|へいわ}→平和：01507_heiwa⟧な⟦{日々|ひび}→日々：04804_hibi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{戻|もど}って→戻る：01117_modoru⟧きた。
examples.english: The war ended, and the peaceful days people had longed for returned.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {待|ま}ち{望|のぞ}んで⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧~: the long-awaited ~
- ⟦{平和|へいわ}→平和：01507_heiwa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{待|ま}ち{望|のぞ}む: to long for peace
- ⟦{誕生|たんじょう}→誕生：01460_tanjou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{待|ま}ち{望|のぞ}む: to look forward eagerly to a birth

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{楽|たの}しみにする→楽しみにする：26825_tanoshiminisuru⟧: to look forward to — the everyday phrase; {待|ま}ち{望|のぞ}む is stronger and a little more formal
- ⟦お{待|ま}ちかね→お待ちかね：32349_omachikane⟧: long-awaited — a cheerful phrase for announcing what people have been waiting for
